raw_capture_truth.support_purpose: Preserve raw capture, timestamp, pose, rights, privacy, and provenance evidence indefinitely (ARCHIVE class after 365 days) so future world-model training and support review never lose capture truth.

temporary_processing.support_purpose: Keep transient processing evidence only long enough to debug failed ingest, privacy processing, provider staging, or package assembly.

buyer_eval_hosted_artifacts.support_purpose: Retain delivered package, hosted-review, and robot-evaluation evidence for buyer support, dispute review, and provenance audit.

local_output_snapshots.support_purpose: Keep local proof snapshots bounded and make current launch artifacts explicit before operator handoff.
local_output_snapshots.claim_boundary: Local output snapshots are not authoritative raw capture storage, live provider proof, legal deletion proof, or bucket lifecycle proof.

local_robot_eval_jobs_cache.support_purpose: Bound developer-machine robot-eval scratch/cache growth while preserving current launch evidence only when explicitly selected.
local_robot_eval_jobs_cache.claim_boundary: Repo-root robot_eval_jobs entries are local cache snapshots and are not launch proof unless selected by the current launch readiness packet or copied into a current operator evidence bundle.

operator_signoff.required_evidence: Operator DPA or equivalent data-processing terms covering retention policy, subprocessor list, and access-audit terms for delivered packages and hosted review access.
operator_signoff.claim_boundary: This artifact declares and validates Blueprint's beta retention policy; it does not prove signed operator approval or access-audit terms.

required_checks: policy schema and status are pinned
policy data classes match the committed GCS lifecycle classes
local output and robot_eval_jobs retention limits are pinned
support operations evidence window is pinned
operator DPA evidence id remains manual-required
claim boundaries forbid treating the artifact as signed DPA, live bucket apply proof, or user-deletion execution proof
